channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'Worse than C-grade cinema': Gaurav Gogoi blasts CM Sarma over Pakistan-link claims
item.description: Assam Congress chief and Lok Sabha MP Gaurav Gogoi sharply criticised Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma over allegations linking him to Pakistan, calling the CM's press conference "worse than a C-grade cinema."

item.title: 51 pc of India Inc rank cyber breaches as top risk to organisational performance: Report
item.description: Artificial intelligence has emerged as a dual risk, with concerns around both inadequate adoption and weak governance. The survey underscores a shift among India Inc towards embedding risk management into core strategy, governance and long-term planning amid converging global and technological risks.

item.title: 'Deals must be win-win, isolation not an option': Mohan Bhagwat on India-US trade agreement
item.description: Speaking at the Mumbai Vyakhyanmala lecture series, he stressed the need for balanced, win-win agreements, strong and fearless governance, and cautious, well-tested reforms in agriculture.

item.title: Four arrested for assaulting tourist in J&K's Doda
item.description: Police in Jammu and Kashmir's Doda district have arrested four people for allegedly assaulting a tourist in the Bhaderwah area. Acting on a written complaint, the police initiated preventive action under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita to avoid any escalation.

item.title: WPBL 2026: Aamir Khan falls during pickleball match, gets up smiling, continues playing; fans laud his fitness at 60
item.description: Aamir Khan played a friendly exhibition pickleball match with fans at WPBL 2026 in Mumbai, where he briefly slipped mid-game. The 60-year-old quickly got up, smiled, and resumed playing, earning praise from fans for his fitness and sportsmanship.

item.title: Deepika Padukone flaunts Rs 22 crore Cartier necklace, slays in black figure-hugging gown [reactions]
item.description: Deepika Padukone wore a customised version of designer Gaurav Gupta's iconic 'Starfall' silhouette, featuring a tailored black jacket paired with a sleek, floor-length skirt. The ensemble was reimagined especially for her from Gupta's The Divine Androgyne Spring Summer '26 collection, which originally debuted in Paris.

item.title: Ranbir Kapoor, Vicky Kaushal, Shilpa Shetty attend RSS centenary celebration; Mohan Bhagwat praises Salman Khan
item.description: Akshay Kumar, Ananya Panday, Karan Johar and Vicky Kaushal were among the Bollywood personalities who attended the second day of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh's 100-year celebrations at the Nehru Centre in Mumbai.

item.title: Displaying 'empty trunk', Tejasvi Surya detained during protest in Bengaluru
item.description: Tejasvi Surya staged a symbolic protest at R.V. Road Metro Station by displaying an empty trunk and a poster targeting the Congress-led Karnataka government over the Bengaluru Metro fare hike. Police detained him, stating protests are restricted under court orders. Surya argued he was merely travelling by Metro and claimed his detention violated parliamentary privilege.

item.title: Gold, silver prices jump as US dollar weakens
item.description: MCX gold February futures rose 1.31% to Rs 1,57,484 per 10 grams, while MCX silver March futures surged 4.81% to Rs 2,61,900 per kg, after touching an intraday high of Rs 2,64,885 per kg.
